forehand.canonical_goal: Create a repeatable contact window and racket-head speed while preserving balance and recovery options.
non_negotiables: sequenced acceleration rather than arm-only hit
balanced recovery appropriate to court position

G1: read bounce, depth, pace and side early
G2: organize torso and racket without freezing the feet
G3: arrive with enough space; technique family may differ
G4: load appropriate to stance and time pressure
G6: meet ball in a repeatable strike zone compatible with intent
G7: continue racket path through intended shape
G8: finish is an outcome of swing shape, not a pose to copy
G9: recover based on opponent and court geometry

two_handed_backhand.canonical_goal: Use the trunk and both arms as a coordinated system to create stable spacing, racket speed and directional control.
non_negotiables: space for both arms to work
top/non-dominant arm contribution appropriate to technique family
trunk contribution without losing head control

G1: recognize early enough to organize two hands
G2: turn with hands connected to torso while feet keep adjusting
G4: load through legs/trunk according to stance
G5: initiate coordinated forward sequence; avoid isolated dominant-arm pull
G6: contact in front/alongside according to grip and direction
G7: extend through intended ball path before wrapping

one_handed_backhand.canonical_goal: Create time and space for a long hitting radius, stable trunk and well-timed extension through contact.
non_negotiables: contact sufficiently forward for technique family

slice_backhand.canonical_goal: Control racket-face/path and body momentum to produce a low, penetrating or intentionally soft ball with reliable depth/height.
non_negotiables: stable racket face through contact window
forward component appropriate to intended depth

serve.canonical_goal: Convert ground force and coordinated segment rotations into upward/forward racket-head speed with repeatable toss-contact geometry and safe deceleration.

S3: organize trophy without forcing a static pose
S4: load compatible with stance and mobility
S5: racket drop emerges from sequence; do not chase depth alone
S8: allow pronation/internal rotation and deceleration pattern

forehand_volley.canonical_goal: Use a compact, stable racket structure and body movement to redirect pace with precision.
non_negotiables: contact in front of body line when possible

backhand_volley.canonical_goal: Use a compact, supported racket structure and body movement to redirect pace with precision.

overhead.canonical_goal: Move behind the lob early, organize an overhead throwing pattern, contact high and recover safely.

return_of_serve.canonical_goal: Read serve cues, time the split step, create a compact strike solution and neutralize or attack without over-swinging.

half_volley.canonical_goal: Stabilize the racket and posture to absorb/redirect a ball immediately after the bounce while continuing transition movement.
